summary: Phase 1 Reports Testing Complete - All 27 backend tests pass. 3 new report tabs (Outstanding, Purchase, Stock Movement) and 6 export endpoints verified. Frontend compiles with 0 TypeScript errors. Backend APIs return correct structure. Firebase Auth required for UI integration testing.

CORRECT: Stock movement uses $facet aggregation for opening stock calculation before date range
CORRECT: Closing stock formula: opening + inward - outward + adjustment
CORRECT: All reports have pagination with page/limit/total/pages fields
CORRECT: All reports accept date filters (startDate, endDate)
CORRECT: Export endpoints support both CSV and XLSX formats with proper content-type headers
CORRECT: Frontend tabs use dynamic data-testid={`tab-${t.key}`}
CORRECT: Frontend filters (buyer/supplier/product) reset pagination on change

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 1 Reports feature fully verified at API level. 3 new tabs (Outstanding, Purchase, Stock Movement) added to /seller/business-tools/reports page. Backend APIs at /api/business-tools/reports/{outstanding,purchase,stock-movement} return correct structure with summary cards, pagination, and filtering. Export endpoints at /api/business-tools/export/{outstanding,purchase-orders,stock-movement} support CSV/XLSX. Frontend requires Firebase Auth for UI testing - use authenticated session or mock. dev-test-token works for backend API testing. Test data: 40 invoices, 4 POs, 25 inventory_logs in database per main agent context.
